TZA.note: The document does not mention civil register and ID exchange.

facts.fact: NIDA says it has registered 27,520,835 people and issued 23,515,667 National Identification Numbers; the registered count is about 39 percent of the 70.5 million population held (2025), calculated here.
The Home Affairs Minister said preparations are underway to register children so that every Tanzanian has a National Identification Number.

TZA.note: It says NIDA has expanded offices and staff but not who builds or maintains the system.
It directs integration with institutions generally and names no register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: NIDA says it has issued 23,515,667 National Identification Numbers and produced 21,526,635 identity cards.
